title: Accrued Earnings Terms of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan
content:
The Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan measures access against net earnings accrued in the current pay period from the employer feed, the base of the access percentage, reset on payday. The tier terms below decide which earnings count toward that accrual and when.

| Tier | Earnings availability lag (calendar days after a shift's earnings sync) | Card tips from the point-of-sale feed count | Overtime hours count | Shift differential pay counts | Gross-to-net estimation percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 1 | no | yes | yes | 70 percent |
| Paystride Access Standard | 1 | no | yes | yes | 70 percent |
| Paystride Access Plus | 1 | yes | yes | yes | 70 percent |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 0 | yes | yes | yes | 70 percent |
| Paystride Access Premier | 0 | yes | yes | yes | 70 percent |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 0 | yes | yes | yes | 70 percent |

## Definitions

- **Earnings availability lag** — the calendar days after a shift's earnings sync before those earnings count toward accrued net (days).
- **Card tips** — whether card tips reported by the employer's point-of-sale feed count toward accrued net earnings.
- **Overtime** — whether overtime hours count toward accrued net earnings.
- **Shift differential** — whether shift differential pay counts toward accrued net earnings.
- **Gross-to-net estimation percentage** — the percent of gross used as estimated net when the employer feed reports gross only.

## Points of reading

- Card tips count from Paystride Access Plus upward and not on Paystride Access Starter or Paystride Access Standard.
- The lag is one calendar day on the three lower tiers and none on the three upper tiers.
- Overtime, shift differential and the 70 percent estimation figure are the same on every tier.

**Hypothetical reading.** Where the employer feed reports a gross of 120.00 USD only, 70 percent of it, 84.00 USD, is the estimated net figure this term supplies.
